packageRules.description: Delay public package updates for stability

How to update Go modules, for EVERY update type. Kept separate from the automerge rule below so a major bump still gets a tidied go.sum: gomodTidy was previously scoped to patch/minor, which left major PRs with a stale go.sum that fails CI on the first missing entry. gomodMassage ignores `replace` directives while tidying, which matters for kits developed against sibling checkouts. constraintsFiltering respects each repo's `go` directive instead of proposing versions it cannot compile.
Require manual approval for major updates
Security PR labels and behavior for OSV/security-related updates
Pin goldmark-emoji to v1.x to prevent major v2 bump being bundled into unrelated PRs (e.g. go toolchain bumps). Consumed only by gdk-markdown.

Our own immutable, timestamp-tagged images (registry.bk.glpx.pro): auto-merge on green CI. Tag format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS[-<sha7>], emitted by the reusable docker-ci.yml. Newest timestamp wins; the sha suffix is matched but ignored for ordering. MUST stay last so it overrides the generic 'container image updates' group above.

customManagers.description: Detect registry.bk.glpx.pro images in Helm values at any nesting depth (a `repository:` line followed by a `tag:` line). Covers single- and multi-image charts the helm-values manager misses. Versioning + automerge come from the registry packageRule above (matched by package name).

Keep SHA-pinned references to this repo's reusable workflows up to date. Renovate's github-actions manager detects .gitea/workflows files but extracts NOTHING from `uses: mukimovd/.github/...`, because it assumes github.com and cannot resolve a self-hosted Gitea workflow ref — verified on mukimovd/gdk-mcp, whose dashboard lists the file with zero dependencies. That makes an unmanaged SHA pin a trap rather than a safety measure: go-agent pinned docker-ci.yml at 335b230f and sat 8 commits / 12 days stale, silently missing every fix. This manager resolves the pin against main's head via git-refs so a pinned consumer gets a reviewable bump PR instead of freezing. Inert for repos still on @main. Scope covers three roots because a reusable-workflow ref is not confined to .gitea/workflows: consumers call these from .github/workflows too (go-agent's go-ci pin lives there, and being out of scope is exactly why it drifted to 33 commits / 26 days stale — worse than the 8/12 that motivated this manager), and templates/ci/ is where new repos are scaffolded from, so an unmanaged pin there is inherited by every future repo.
